name: Poppy Seed Loaf Delight
author: Chris Crawley
steps: For 2 minutes with mixer, mix flour, salt, baking powder, eggs, milk, oil, poppy seed, 2.25 cups of the sugar, and 1.5 tsp each of the vanilla, almond extract, and butter flavoring.
Pour into 2 large or 4 small greased loaf pans. Bake at 350 degrees one hour for large pans or 45-50 minutes for small pans.
Prepare the glaze by mixing the orange juice with the remaining 0.75 cups of sugar and 0.5 tsp each of vanilla, almond extract, and butter flavoring.
Use toothpick to check when the cake is done. Cool 5 minutes and then pour glaze over.
NOTE: Loaves will split somewhat in the middle, this is normal; if the edges seem to be getting too brown and the middle not done, adjust your oven temperature down just a little bit.
